The '''Tunnel 2-A''',<ref name="TOR:WL" /> nicknamed '''Ruined Dig Site''', was a [[Mining/Legends|mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]]. At the time of the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]], it was inhabited by the legendary [[tineback]] known as [[Kithrawl]].<ref name="TOR:BoG" />
